crossRefs.note: You shall drink from the brook. I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.”
The ravens brought him bread and meat in the morning, and bread and meat in the evening; and he drank from the brook.
Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

translations.web: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.
translations.bsb: and sent out a raven. It kept flying back and forth until the waters had dried up from the earth.
translations.kjv: And he sent forth a raven, which went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
translations.asv: and he sent forth a raven, and it went forth to and fro, until the waters were dried up from off the earth.
